text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well, as a wise man once said…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: If the fish aren't biting, they're just giving you time to think instead.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Pretty cool, right? I really was able to get some decent pondering done.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Different lures, different casting spots—I came up with all kinds of tactics. It was real fun.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Sigh… Still, where's the thrill in setting a trap if nothing takes the bait?
